name: Latulla
description: Keldon overseer who led the invasion to obtain tufa and awaken the Witch-Kings.

description_citations.text: "Prophecy War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Latulla gives Greel a gift, whom he intends to play with.
timeline.quote: You're Latulla's gift to me, and I always play with my presents.

citation.text: Greel, Mind Raker (Prophecy, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greel slays Rayne in the final battle of the Prophecy War, and Barrin in rage destroys the Keldon army, Greel and the overlord Latulla.

citation.text: "Barrin", section "The Prophecy War in Jamuraa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldons launch the Prophecy War, invading Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: A few months before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria, the Keldons launched their invasion of Jamuraa.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Prophecy War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Latulla is defeated by Gorsha and Druik is killed at the Necropolis.
timeline.quote: Latulla was defeated by Doyenne Gorsha and Druik was killed.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Prophecy War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Barrin defeat and destroy Latulla's banished followers in Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: were eventually defeated and destroyed by the planeswalker Teferi and Barrin the Master Wizard.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Prophecy War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldons raid the Jamuraan coast, take hostages and settle, while the Kipamu League is unable to resist.
timeline.quote: Keldon forces razed villages, captured hostages, and established a permanent settlement

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gorsha kills Druik in ritual combat, defeats Latulla and exiles her and her followers.
timeline.quote: In ritual combat, Gorsha killed Druik and defeated Latulla

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Barrin dissolves Greel with a spark spell and then executes the crushed Latulla.
timeline.quote: Barrin used a cascading spark spell to dissolve Greel into minute parts, killing him.

citation.text: "Prophecy War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: took the life of the Keldon overlord
relations.quote: even took the life of the Keldon overlord Latulla .

citation.text: "Barrin", section "The Prophecy War in Jamuraa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
